context:
Goal: search on the phone works as well as the web's.
Problem (goal): the designer drew a clear (x) button in the phone's search pill. The web's pill has none, and clearing a query with the iOS keyboard takes many taps.
Based on (read): src/app.jsx .mdl-pill has no clear button.
Departs from: src/app.jsx:mdl-pill — the web pill has no clear button; option a adds a clear (x) button inside the phone's search pill.
Meanwhile: the lane builds option b, the web's behaviour.
home: roadmap step restyle-8-head (restyle builds the clear button in step 8)

options.how: An (x) inside the phone's search pill empties the query in one tap.
options.label: Add the clear button
options.lose: The phone differs from the web here.

options.how: The phone's pill matches the web's, with no clear button.
options.label: No clear button, as on the web
options.lose: Clearing a search takes many keyboard taps.

ref: restyle step 8 design (head cells, search and filters); decision port-keeps-behaviour (a port keeps the app's behaviour)
title: Should the phone's search pill get a clear (x) button the web doesn't have?
why: The phone has no select-all-and-delete as fast as a desktop's.
